newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius shares extend gains across market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius shares extend gains across market.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index Semdex rose 3.61 points to 317.16 on Wednesday, as shares gained across the market, brokers said.
Turnover surged to 10.25 million rupees on 567,311 shares from 1.99 million rupees on 112,632 shares.
Brokers said market sentiment was buoyed by news about the establishment of a new country fund which is to buy $15 million worth listed stocks in 1997.

Mauritian Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam announced on October 24 the creation of the Port Louis Fund Ltd. It was seen as a government incentive to revitalise private sector confidence which was badly hit by an unpopular 1996/97 budget last May.

One finance ministry official said on October 28 that the Port Louis Fund, to be launched by March 1997, was the first of a series of government economic measures to revitalise businesses, especially in the financial services, offshore and freeport sectors.

"There is a will to put the budget episode behind. The announcement of the Port Louis Fund gave a much needed boost to the market which until last week, was still depressed on political uncertainty. We can only hope that this will continue," one broker said.

Leading listed shares, likely investment targets of the Port Louis Fund, continued to propel forward ahead the extended weekend. The Mauritius bourse will be closed on Friday because of the All Saints public holiday.

Mauritius Commercial Bank rose 1.0 to 73.0 rupees on 26,770 shares and the State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 8.60 rupees on 296,338 shares. Fincorp gained 50 cents to 70 rupees on 3,083 shares, Promotion And Development was 20 cents higher to 13.50 rupees on 22,465 shares and the National Investment Trust added 20 cents to 11.10 rupees on 5,900 shares.

Harel Freres edged up 50 cents to 41.50 rupees on a heavy 10,600 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert climbed 50 cents to 35 rupees on 3,069 shares. Rogers was 1.0 up to 85 rupees on 6,988 shares, Ireland Blyth surged 40 cents to 13.20 rupees on 5,360 shares.
